Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source, is the edited image consistently rendered as a chalk drawing across the image, rather than showing only a partial chalk-like treatment?
node.criteria: Pass if the source has been transformed into a coherent chalk-made drawing across the image, with chalk-like texture and rendering consistently applied to the main subjects and surrounding scene. Fail if there is no requested chalk-drawing progress, or if chalk-like rendering is present but visibly incomplete or inconsistent across the image. Unknown if the source or edited image is unavailable or evidence is insufficient to judge.
node.binding: Compare the source and edited images for visible coverage and consistency of the chalk medium across the main subjects and scene; judge the requested chalk-drawing transformation, not a particular style.

node_traces.evidence: The edited image consistently has a chalk-drawing appearance across both giraffes and the surrounding scene: forms are softened and sketch-like, with visible grainy, dusty texture and chalk-like shading throughout. The treatment covers the main subjects and background rather than appearing only in isolated areas.

response.content: {"text":"The node’s criterion is directionally appropriate, but its trace confidently labels the edit complete despite the reference being partial. The image does show chalk-like grain and softened rendering across the scene, yet substantial photographic structure and detail remain—especially in the giraffes’ recognizable photographic anatomy and spots—so coverage alone should not establish a complete chalk-drawing transformation. Refine the decision to distinguish visible medium cues from whether the source has actually been transformed into a coherent drawing, and assess both subjects and background for residual source-like rendering. Calibrate confidence to mixed evidence and allow partial when meaningful chalk treatment is present but the transformation is incomplete; do not infer absence of progress. The trace is valid and has no dependency or transport failure, so this is a semantic criterion/application issue, not an execution problem."}
